# cb:b120

> Beliefs and contracts are two roles sharing one store. Ordinary beliefs become stale and get superseded. Contracts are behavioral invariants that get violated or upheld, not superseded. A belief says 'this is true'; a contract says 'this will remain true.'

**Type:** prescription · **Kind:** convention · **Domain:**  · **Status:** active

## Evidence

1. **2026-03-23** - Beliefs versus contracts: ordinary beliefs carry statuses active/superseded/retracted; contracts are contract-grade implications that may additionally use retired. Both live in the same store.
